WPSS No. 577 of 2023
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Dinesh Chandra Gahtori, 
Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Atul Bahuguna, Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand/respondent 
nos. 1 to 3.
Petitioner served as daily wager in 
Nagar Panchayat Shaktigarh before his 
regularisation, which was made on 
15.02.2008. Now, petitioner has retired 
from service on 31.08.2021. Petitioner 
has claimed pension, gratuity and other 
benefits in this writ petition. 
Learned State Counsel has drawn 
attention of this Court to a letter issued 
by Director, Accounts (Audit), 
Uttarakhand, which is addressed to 
Executive Officer, Nagar Panchayat, 
Shaktigarh. Perusal of the said letter 
reveals that a sum of Rs. 2,25,024/- was 
to be paid to petitioner as gratuity. 
Learned counsel for petitioner contends 
that the said amount has also not been 
paid to petitioner.  Issue notice to respondent no. 4, 
returnable within four weeks.
Steps to be taken within 48 hours. 
Learned State Counsel may also file 
counter affidavit within four weeks.
List this case on 09.06.2023, along 
with WPSS No. 710 of 2022.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 18.04.2023
Navin
